name: Inui Ichigo
source:
Ichigo is the older sister of Arihiko Inui. Known to be a heavy smoker. She works at night, and sleeps in the day, demanding that her younger brother keeps quiet. No one knows what her job actually is, and Arihiko has wondered about it for many years.

[From [url=http://typemoon.wikia.com/wiki/Hanei_Misawa]TYPE-MOON Wiki[/url].]
